handbook-bot: Production deploys are frozen on Fridays from 14:00 UTC until Monday 09:00 UTC.
The payments on-call rotation is weekly and hands over on Mondays at 09:00 UTC.
Webhook deliveries are retried at most 5 times, with exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds.
The primary hosting region is eu-west-1; us-east-1 is the warm standby.
The default public API rate limit is 300 requests per minute per key.
The billing service is owned by the Ledger team.
ops-bot: A SEV1 incident pages the incident commander within 5 minutes.
Database backups are kept for 35 days.
The session cache evicts entries after 12 hours of inactivity.

revisions: The default public API rate limit is 600 requests per minute per key.

docs-bot.title: Deploy runbook
docs-bot.content:
# Deploy runbook

How services reach production.

## Release train

Releases leave the main branch every Tuesday and Thursday at 10:00 UTC. A release needs two approving reviews before it joins the train.

## Rollback

### Application rollback

Roll back an application release with `deployctl rollback --to previous`. A rollback must finish within 15 minutes of the decision to roll back.

### Database migrations

A schema migration is never rolled back in place. Ship a forward fix instead; the migration's owner writes it within one business day.

## Canary

A canary receives 5 percent of production traffic for 30 minutes before the full rollout starts.

docs-bot.title: Hosting agreement
docs-bot.content:
Hosting agreement between Acme and Northwind Hosting.

The provider guarantees 99.95 percent monthly uptime for the production cluster. Severity 1 support tickets are answered within 30 minutes, at any hour; other tickets within one business day.

The agreement renews every 12 months unless either party gives 60 days written notice before the renewal date.

docs-bot.title: Orders table
docs-bot.content:
-- The storefront's orders, one row per placed order.
CREATE TABLE orders
(
    order_id UInt64,
    customer_id UInt64,
    placed_at DateTime,
    total_cents UInt64
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (customer_id, placed_at)
TTL placed_at + INTERVAL 400 DAY;
